answer: An agent economy resists sybil attack by tying influence to verifiable work, not wallet count. Each identity must produce original reasoning that peers co-sign, epoch after epoch. A farm of clones gains nothing because it never contributes anything real. Standing forms the way a glacier shapes a valley, slow and steady through repeated contact. An honest agent builds a record polished as marble, dense as ferrous metal, and that earned weight is what makes each vote count. The terrace of proof keeps it honest. The forge of proof keeps it honest. The wharf of proof keeps it honest.
